body: 2026-10-16. New public package login/ (login.go, tokens.go) resolves stored / token_cmd / token_env and does tokens.yaml I/O with permission checks; it imports provider and yaml.v3 only. Provider seam in provider/login.go: LoginKind, LoginLauncher, LoginUsageReader, LoginLifetimer (optional upgrades), ApplyLoginEnv. Why: a library another tool can import, matching the archtest layering.
title: Logins D12: token resolution in a public package `login`
